tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-deep-blue
tokens.usage: Foundation, stability, neural depth. Used as background on `.data-table thead`.

tokens.name: color-darker-blue
tokens.usage: Technical environment, focus, reduced eye strain. Used as background on `body`; text on `.stat-icon`, `.btn-primary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-cyan
tokens.usage: Data flow, active connections, information streams. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.network-status`, `.page-title`. 8.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-purple
tokens.usage: Processing centers, intelligence points, key nodes. Used as background on `body`, `.card-badge`, `.badge-neural`.

tokens.name: color-teal
tokens.usage: Highlights, active states, successful processing. Used as text on `.stat-trend`. 8.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav-link`, `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: badge-error-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.stat-trend.negative`, `.badge-error`; background on `.badge-error`. 7.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: badge-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.badge-warning`; text on `.badge-warning`. 12.1:1 on `page-bg`.
